name: 1Password Connect
description: Vaults and items of 1Password through a self-hosted 1Password Connect server: list vaults and items, read items with their secret values and attached files, create items with generated passwords, update them with JSON Patch, and read the server's request log. Delete is switched off at install.
instructions:
## 1Password Connect
This connector talks to a **1Password Connect server**, the self-hosted REST API (`<your Connect address>/v1`) that 1Password runs in your own infrastructure for Secrets Automation. Through it the AI can list vaults and items, read items and their files, create items, change them with JSON Patch and read the server's request log. It only reaches the shared vaults the Connect token was granted, never Personal or Private vaults.

**The AI sees secret values**: `onepassword_connect_get_item` returns an item's passwords, API keys, TOTP seeds and other concealed fields in plain text, and `onepassword_connect_get_file_content` returns attached files; `onepassword_connect_create_item` and `onepassword_connect_update_item` answer with the full item as well. These values go to the AI model and the chat. The list tools (`onepassword_connect_list_vaults`, `onepassword_connect_list_items`, `onepassword_connect_list_files`) and `onepassword_connect_get_vault`, `onepassword_connect_get_file` return metadata only. Grant the token only the vaults the AI should see, and switch off `onepassword_connect_get_item` and `onepassword_connect_get_file_content` if the AI should work with names only. Never repeat a secret in an answer unless the user asked for it.

**Setup (about 15 minutes, needs a deployed Connect server)**
1. On 1Password.com open **Developer**, **Directory**, select **Other** under Infrastructure Secrets Management and **Create a Connect server** (or run `op connect server create <name> --vaults <vault>`). Save the `1password-credentials.json` and the first access token in 1Password. Connect only reaches shared vaults granted to it.
2. Deploy the server (the `connect-api` and `connect-sync` containers from https://github.com/1Password/connect, Docker Compose, Kubernetes or the Helm chart). By default it listens on port 8080.
3. Use the first token, or issue one for the AI: **Developer**, **Connect servers**, choose the server, **New Token** (or `op connect token create <name> --server <server> --vault <vault>`). Grant only the vaults the AI should see; a token's vaults cannot be changed later, so revoke it and issue a new one instead. An expiry of 30, 90 or 180 days can be set.
4. Set `ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL` to the server's address as AnythingMCP reaches it, without `/v1` (e.g. `https://op-connect.example.com`), and paste the token into `ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_TOKEN`.
5. Install; `onepassword_connect_list_vaults` checks the token. On AnythingMCP Cloud the Connect server needs a public HTTPS address. A self-hosted AnythingMCP can reach a server on a private network or IP only once that host is allowed through `SSRF_ALLOWED_HOSTS`, because the outbound guard blocks private address space by default.

**Workflow**
- Find a secret: `onepassword_connect_list_vaults` (filter `name eq "Production"`), then `onepassword_connect_list_items` (filter `title eq "Stripe API"` or `tag eq "prod"`), then `onepassword_connect_get_item` only if the value itself is needed. `onepassword_connect_get_vault` shows one vault's details.
- Files: `onepassword_connect_list_files` or `onepassword_connect_get_file` for names and sizes, `onepassword_connect_get_file_content` to download one.
- Store a new secret: `onepassword_connect_create_item` with a category, title and fields; set `generate: true` and a `recipe` on a field to let 1Password create a random password.
- Rotate or edit: `onepassword_connect_update_item` with JSON Patch, e.g. `[{"op": "replace", "path": "/fields/<field id>/value", "value": "..."}]`. Read the field ids with `onepassword_connect_get_item` first. `{"op": "replace", "path": "/", "value": {...}}` replaces the whole item.
- Who used the server: `onepassword_connect_list_activity` (READ, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE with SUCCESS or DENY, per token and item). `onepassword_connect_get_health` shows whether the server and its sync service are healthy.
- **Switched off at install**: `onepassword_connect_delete_item`; it cannot be undone, so an admin switches it on when the team needs it.

**Reading the answers**: vault and item ids are 26 lower-case letters and digits. A field has `id`, `label`, `type` (STRING, CONCEALED, EMAIL, URL, TOTP, DATE, MONTH_YEAR, MENU), `purpose` (USERNAME, PASSWORD, NOTES), `value` and `section`; password fields also carry `entropy`. Dates are ISO 8601. Lists return the whole collection in one answer; only `onepassword_connect_list_activity` pages with `limit` and `offset` and reports the total in the `content-range` header (`1-50/1134`).

**Errors**: 401 means a wrong or revoked token; 403 `vault ... is not in scope` means the token was not granted that vault, or may not write to it; 404 means the vault, item or file does not exist; 400 on a write names the invalid field or category; 413 means a file is too large to return. Connection errors usually mean `ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL` is not reachable from AnythingMCP; `onepassword_connect_get_health` and the server logs tell more.
prerequisites: A 1Password account with a deployed 1Password Connect server reachable from AnythingMCP, and a Connect access token for the vaults the AI may use.

ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL.label: Connect server address
ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL.help: The address of your Connect server's API as AnythingMCP reaches it, without /v1 and without a trailing slash (port 8080 by default).
ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL.patternMessage: Use the server address, e.g. https://op-connect.example.com or http://10.0.0.5:8080, without /v1 and without a trailing slash.

ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_TOKEN.label: Connect access token
ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_TOKEN.help: An access token issued for this Connect server (1Password.com, Developer, Connect servers, New Token, or op connect token create). It reaches only the vaults chosen for it.
ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_TOKEN.patternMessage: Paste the whole access token (a JWT that starts with eyJ and has two dots), without Bearer in front.

verifyHints.401: The Connect server refused the access token: it is wrong, revoked or was issued for another Connect server.
verifyHints.403: The token is valid but not allowed to reach this vault or to write to it. Issue a token for the vaults and access the AI needs.
verifyHints.404: Nothing answered at this path. Check that ONEPASSWORD_CONNECT_URL is the Connect API address, without /v1.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_list_vaults
tools.description: List the vaults this Connect token can reach: id, name, description, type, number of items, versions and dates. Metadata only, no item contents.

filter.description: Optional SCIM filter on the vault name, e.g. name eq "Production".

tools.name: onepassword_connect_get_vault
tools.description: One vault's details and metadata: name, description, type, item count, attribute and content versions, created and updated dates. No item contents.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

tools.name: onepassword_connect_list_items
tools.description: List the items in a vault as metadata only: id, title, category, tags, urls, favorite, version, state and dates. It returns no field values, passwords or files; use onepassword_connect_get_item for those.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

filter.description: Optional SCIM filter on title or tag, e.g. title eq "Stripe API" or tag eq "prod".

tools.name: onepassword_connect_get_item
tools.description: Read one item in full. WARNING: this returns the item's SECRET VALUES in plain text (passwords, API keys, TOTP seeds, concealed fields, notes) in fields[].value, together with sections, urls, tags and file references. Call it only when the user needs that secret, and never repeat a value back unless asked.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_list_files
tools.description: List the files attached to an item (Document items and file fields): id, name, size in bytes, section and content_path. Metadata only; onepassword_connect_get_file_content downloads one.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_get_file
tools.description: Details of one file attached to an item: id, name, size in bytes, section and content_path. Metadata only.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.

file_id.description: File id from onepassword_connect_list_files or the item's files array.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_get_file_content
tools.description: Download the content of a file attached to an item (certificates, key files, documents). WARNING: files kept in 1Password are often secret themselves; the content is returned to the AI. Images and other files are attached to the result, up to 4 MB.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.

file_id.description: File id from onepassword_connect_list_files or the item's files array.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_list_activity
tools.description: Requests this Connect server has handled, newest first: requestId, timestamp, action (READ, CREATE, UPDATE, DELETE), result (SUCCESS, DENY), the token used (actor.jti, userAgent, requestIp) and the vault and item touched. The content-range header (e.g. 1-50/1134) gives the total.

offset.description: How many requests to skip (default 0); add limit to page on.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_get_health
tools.description: State of the Connect server: name, version and its dependencies (the sync service and the account connection) with their status. Use it when calls fail to tell a server problem from a token problem.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_create_item
tools.description: Create an item in a vault. Pass the category, a title and its fields; a field with generate true and a recipe gets a new random value from 1Password (the generated value is returned in the answer). Returns the full item, including its secret values.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

category.description: Item category; LOGIN, PASSWORD, API_CREDENTIAL, SERVER, DATABASE and SECURE_NOTE are the usual ones for infrastructure secrets.

fields.description: Item fields. Each: {label, type (STRING, EMAIL, CONCEALED, URL, TOTP, DATE, MONTH_YEAR, MENU), value, purpose (USERNAME, PASSWORD or NOTES, for LOGIN and PASSWORD items), section: {id}, generate: true with recipe: {length 1 to 64, characterSets [LETTERS, DIGITS, SYMBOLS], excludeCharacters}}.

sections.description: Sections fields can refer to: [{id, label}]. The id is any string you choose.

favorite.description: Mark the item as a favourite.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_update_item
tools.description: Change part of an item with RFC 6902 JSON Patch operations (add, remove, replace). Paths: /title, /favorite, /tags, /urls, /fields to add a field, /fields/<field id> to replace or remove one, /fields/<field id>/value or /label for one attribute, / to replace the whole item. Field ids come from onepassword_connect_get_item. 1Password keeps the previous version in the item's history. Returns the full updated item, including its secret values.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.

tools.name: onepassword_connect_delete_item
tools.description: Delete an item from a vault. Applications that read this secret through Connect stop finding it at once. Switched off at install.

vault_id.description: Vault id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_vaults (e.g. ftz4pm2xxwmwrsd7rjqn7grzfz).

item_id.description: Item id: the 26-character id from onepassword_connect_list_items.
